description: Standard methods at world and French places, 2024-2032, incl. DST change days, 29 Feb, year end. Expected minutes come from the bit-exact Python port of the Mawaqit PHP library (study 4/engines/mawaqit_backend.py, 0 mismatches against the real PHP on 148,687 values). Minutes are minutes after local midnight; Isha before 06:00 is +1440. float_hours are the unrounded local hours, for diagnosing a value that sits on a rounding boundary. utc_offset_hours is the offset the generator took from its time-zone database at local noon: check the arithmetic with that offset, and report a different offset from your platform as a time-zone database difference, not an engine error (Morocco rules differ between tzdata releases).
